score.metric: generated complete-update median ms / fastest valid tested conventional complete-update median ms, fixed primary case
score.clock: CUDA events over CUDA-graph replays of one complete changing-state update (init, K-step chain, positives, loss, gradients, casts, clip+AdamW, replay commit); state restored before each paired round; randomized arm order; same H100 and job; bootstrap 95% CI of the median ratio (c_ops4_b.gpu_tasks.perf)
score.memory_and_setup: reported separately (native arena + bindings; controls allocator peak delta; CPU capture/lower/nvcc and GPU load/compile/capture seconds); never folded into the score

added_before_measurement.fused_autotune_cd: fused_autotune plus Inductor coordinate_descent_tuning (same equations and BF16 product policy)
added_before_measurement.bf16_fused_autotune: practical BF16: network activations, products and their gradients held in BF16 (x/y sampler state, loss, parameter master copies and AdamW in FP32), whole update torch.compile max-autotune-no-cudagraphs

validity.same_policy_controls: valid iff the c_ops4_b same-state rule passes (loss, gradients, parameters, moments vs FP64 with C1/C2 calibration) from the same state
validity.practical_bf16_controls: deliberately changed arithmetic, so the same-state rule is reported but not required; valid as a denominator iff a 400-update Fashion-MNIST run from the same init/data/RNG has finite losses and d(control, C1 eager) <= max(2 * d(C2 manual, C1), 0.02) (the native training gate). A control failing that learning run is excluded and its failure retained.

controls.denominator: fastest valid control in the same paired job

native_gates.numerical: c_ops4_b/POLICY.json v1.1 (unchanged): exact init/commit/counters, repeat bitwise, CUDA-graph replay bitwise, status 0, every selected chain-step increment and every update observable within the same-state rule; the original v1 optimizer-tier verdict is reported alongside and its failure retained
native_gates.learning: 400-update Fashion-MNIST training from the shared init: finite losses and d(native, C1) <= max(2 * d(C2, C1), 0.02); all numerical gates repeated at the trained state
native_gates.single_kernel: one generated cooperative kernel launch per complete update; no external kernels, no benchmark-name dispatch
native_gates.qualification_scope: the selected candidate is qualified at fresh and trained WB states, SD fresh, WB counts 8/32 (gates at those counts), tiny/small regression fixtures, and the ops CPU contract tests; failures are retained

precision.declared: no new mixed precision: products keep BF16 operands, FP32 accumulation and one BF16 rounding (summation order inside a product may differ: fixed-order k-split partial chains); elementwise work FP32 with ops.lower expressions, --fmad=false
precision.amendment_rule: any new storage/compute precision must be declared here as a versioned amendment before its validation runs, checked against its arithmetic reference AND the learning gate

compiler_scope: reusable rules reached through ops.lower(...) for any sampled-training graph whose step is row-separable with loop-invariant BF16 product operands; refusals fall back to the existing schedule with a recorded reason; no model names; default byte-identical when the rule is off

amendments.before: any GPU execution of a panel program built with panel_options elementwise='fast'
amendments.scope: declares one optional arithmetic variant of the panel engine's sampler elementwise segments; gates unchanged
amendments.variant: elementwise='fast': inside the sampling-loop segments only, sigmoid/silu use __expf (ex2.approx-based, ~2 ulp) and a correctly rounded reciprocal (__frcp_rn) instead of expf and IEEE division; x/(1+e) becomes x * rcp(1+e). Products, BF16 roundings, Philox/Box-Muller, clamps, the training region and the optimizer are unchanged.
amendments.arithmetic_reference: the unchanged c_ops4_b same-state rule (every sampled chain step and every update observable vs FP64 R, bound 2 x max(C1, C2)) at fresh and trained states
amendments.learning_gate: the native 400-update training gate (finite losses; d(native, C1) <= max(2 d(C2, C1), 0.02)) plus all gates at the trained state
amendments.selection: the variant may be selected only if every gate above passes; failures are retained and the exact-expression candidate is reported regardless
